summary: Amarc Resources Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the listing of its common shares on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (FSE) under symbol AQ5, with ISIN CA0229121094 and WKN 907038. No specific terms, price, premium, or board recommendation were provided. The dual listing is intended to expand European investor access and increase liquidity. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved.
